title: Vigil IPC protocol
description: Protocol version 1. Types live in $defs. x-methods maps each JSON-RPC method to its minimum role, params and result schemas; x-events maps notification methods to their params schema. Contract tests validate sample payloads against these.

reputation.description: Offline destination reputation (docs/15 §4): bad = listed host, risky = generated name, no DNS answer, or risky port/TLD.

alert.description: True when this item is an established incident that may interrupt the user (popup, toast); otherwise it waits quietly in the Pending list.

result.description: analyze: the advisor's opinion (as ai.explain); block: as decision.submit; dismiss: empty.
